description: This file defines the JobSpecificationModel class in the OrangeHRM system, which is a part of the Admin API Model layer. The class represents a data model for job specifications, including properties like id, filename, fileType, and fileSize. It uses traits and annotations for serialization and API documentation, and initializes its properties via a constructor that accepts a PartialJobSpecificationAttachment object.

classes.name: JobSpecificationModel
classes.description: A data model class representing a job specification with properties such as id, filename, fileType, and fileSize, facilitating API serialization and documentation.
